others.route: Special Work Permit – Artists and Athletes

note: Philippines: artists performing in concerts, musicals or public performances, with their production staff and crew, must secure the Bureau of Immigration's Special Work Permit, for at most six months, non-renewable (three months, plus a final three), petitioned by the engaging company. No days of performing without the SWP are named.

sources.title: Bureau of Immigration Philippines, Special Work Permit – Artists and Athletes
sources.said: The following foreign nationals are required to secure an SWP for a maximum of six (6) months, non-renewable, with an initial duration of not more than three (3) months plus a final three (3) month period, if applicable: Artists performing in concerts, musicals, or public performances, including but not limited to, members of the production staff and crew;
